chunks: If they turn away (remember) God knows the mischief-mongers.

key_terms.بِالْمُفْسِدِينَ: the mischief-mongers / those who cause corruption

ai.seo_question: What does it mean when God knows the mischief-mongers in Surah Aal-Imran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the transition from the Prophet's duty of conveyance to God's omniscience regarding the 'mufsidin' (those who spread corruption), often linked to the hypocrites who rejected Imam Ali's authority. It highlights that divine awareness extends beyond mere action to the intent behind the disorder, serving as a reassurance for the faithful amidst political and spiritual trials.
